Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Sanjay - 30 years, son
Look: white kurta-pyjama
2. Sonali - 65 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Sunita - 25 years, friend
Look: red salwar-kameez
4. Kavita - 30 years, daughter
Look: red salwar-kameez
5. Vinod - 35 years, friend
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The airport - check-in counters, big windows
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The airport - Day

[Sanjay stands at the airport. Sonali and Kavita stand near him.]

Sanjay: "Let's do something fun today."

[Sanjay drags his suitcase to the gate.]

Kavita: "What next?"

[Sanjay hugs Mother goodbye at the airport.]

Sonali (happily): "Good job, Kavita!"

[Sanjay waves goodbye as he goes through security.]

Sonali: "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

Vinod: "What a nice place."

[Sanjay pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Vinod: "Careful!"

[Sanjay sips red wine.]

Sanjay (surprised): "That was fun!"

[Sanjay drinks a beer.]

Sanjay (laughing): "What next?"

[Sanjay staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Sanjay (surprised): "And then?"

[Sanjay and Mother clink their glasses.]

Sonali (excited): "That's great!"

Scene 3: The road - Day

Sonali: "Sanjay, look over here."

[Sanjay gets out of the car.]

Sanjay: "And then?"

[Sanjay rides the scooter with Mother sitting behind him.]

Sanjay (surprised): "Really?"

[Sanjay takes Mother to the market on his motorbike, she sits behind him.]

Sanjay: "Show me too!"

[The thug's knife wounds Sanjay in the stomach; he doubles over.]

Vinod: "Oh wow!"

[Sanjay's nose is bleeding after the punch.]

Sonali (gently): "Hmm, I see."

[Sanjay counts the notes and puts them in his wallet.]

Vinod: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
